technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, supertrend, hull) show bullish bias, but price remains below key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-50, SMA-200) and Ichimoku cloud with weak ADX strength and low volume ratio, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signals, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with no supporting smart money conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (575+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (359.68), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI event (1 day), and earnings binary (7 days) create severe macro headwinds for OMC.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9, supertrend, and hull momentum signals are bullish with price near support (55.98), and extreme fear (32/100) presents contrarian opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-50, SMA-200), Ichimoku cloud, with critical earnings binary in 7 days, crisis VIX, imminent CPI event, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction creating unacceptable risk/reward.
